description: This file defines a React component called NoteStatusIndicator, which displays various status indicators related to note synchronization, saving, and errors within the application. It uses imported constants, icons, and hooks, and manages tooltip visibility and user preferences for indication settings.

methods.name: IndicatorWithTooltip
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a tooltip indicator with a button and conditionally visible tooltip content.

methods.name: NoteStatusIndicator
methods.description: Main React component that displays different status indicators (error, saving, saved, disabled) for notes and manages tooltip visibility and user preference toggling.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event to hide tooltip.

methods.name: toggleShowPreference
methods.description: Uses application context to toggle the preference for updating saving status indicator.
